The '''Fire Altar''' is a [[runic altar]] upon which [[fire rune]]s are crafted from [[rune essence]] or [[pure essence]], providing 7 [[Runecraft]] [[experience]] per essence imbued. Level 14 [[Runecraft]] is required to craft fire runes.

Players may create a [[fire tiara]] here by using either a [[fire talisman]] or a [[tiara]] on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 35 [[Runecraft]] [[experience]]. An [[elemental tiara]] can also be created here by using an [[elemental talisman]] and [[gold tiara]], granting 40 Runecraft experience.

Upon entering the Fire Altar, the [[music]] track [[Quest (music track)|Quest]] plays.

==Transportation==
{{Map|name=Fire Altar|align=left|mtype=pin|x = 3312|y = 3254|height = 275|width = 275|caption = The location of the mysterious ruins used to enter the Fire Altar.}}
The entrance to the altar can be found north of [[Al Kharid]], west of the [[Emir's Arena]], the altar can also be accessed through the [[Abyss]]. The [[ring of the elements]] can be used to teleport to the altar.

To enter the [[Mysterious ruins#Fire|mysterious ruins]], players either have to use a [[fire talisman]] on the ruins, or click "Enter" on the ruins while wearing a [[fire tiara]]. Alternatively, an [[elemental talisman]] or [[elemental tiara|tiara]] can be used.

==Experience==
Crafting fire runes with a [[ring of dueling]] is one of the fastest ways to 44 Runecraft. With duel ring teleports, the average round-trip time if walking to the Fire Altar is ~35 seconds if minimising game tick loss (i.e. teleporting right after the animation finishes). This allows for ~20,000 experience an hour. If running to the altar + teleports, one can expect ~27,000 experience an hour, if minimising tick loss. The average round-trip time in this case is ~26 seconds.

==Combination runes==
It is possible to make [[steam rune]]s, [[smoke rune]]s, and [[lava rune]]s while at this altar, but at a 50% success rate. This will result in less runes than normal being made. To make a combination rune, the player needs one set of elemental runes, a stack of pure essence, and 2 talismans.

Note that players need to use the opposing rune on the altar to craft combination runes. Simply clicking on the altar would just result in regular elemental runes.

[[Magic Imbue]] negates the need of a talisman.

If the player equips a [[binding necklace]], the success rate will increase to 100%. The necklace has a total of 16 uses before breaking. A charge is used each time a batch of combination runes is crafted, instead of each time the altar is entered or for each rune crafted.
